name: Elite Advanced Laser
summary: Based in Taiwan, Elite Advanced Laser Corporation specializes in delivering electronic manufacturing services. The company provides comprehensive assembly and rigorous testing solutions for a wide array of advanced components, including optoelectronic, optical information, and both optical and radio frequency (RF) communication devices, along with sensors and power amplifiers. Furthermore, Elite Advanced Laser Corporation manufactures visible laser diodes. Established in 2000, the company operates from its headquarters located in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
